<module id="sequence_detector">
    <description>Design a sequence detector to detect the binary sequence '1001'.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="reset_n">Reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">1-bit binary input signal.</input>
        <output id="sequence_detected">1-bit output signal indicating if the sequence is detected.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Waiting for the start of the sequence.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">First bit of the desired sequence detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">Second bit of the desired sequence detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">Third bit of the desired sequence detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">Fourth and final bit of the desired sequence detected.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" type="enum" values="IDLE,S1,S2,S3,S4">State register.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" type="enum" values="IDLE,S1,S2,S3,S4">Next state register.</reg>
        <always @(posedge clk or posedge reset_n)>
            if (reset_n == 1'b1)
                current_state <= IDLE;
            else
                current_state <= next_state;
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="sequence_detected" value="((current_state==S4))">Asserts when the sequence is detected.</assign>
        <always @(*) begin
            case(current_state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if(data_in==1'b1)
                        next_state = S1;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                S1: begin
                    if(data_in==1'b0)
                        next_state = S2;
                    else
                        next_state = S1;
                end
                S2: begin
                    if(data_in==1'b0)
                        next_state = S3;
                    else
                        next_state = S1;
                end
                S3: begin
                    if(data_in==1'b1)
                        next_state = S4;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                S4: begin
                    if(data_in==1'b1)
                        next_state = S1;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                default: next_state = IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implements a sequence detector using a sequential logic block to manage states and a combinational logic block to define state transitions and outputs.</implementation>
</module>
